298::llvm::LogicalResult AddFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
299 {
300 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
301 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
302
303 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
304 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
305 return ::mlir::failure();
306 }
307 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
308
309 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
310 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
311 return ::mlir::failure();
312 }
313 }
314 {
315 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
316 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
317
318 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
319 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
320 return ::mlir::failure();
321 }
322 }
323 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
324 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
325 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
326 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
327 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
328 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
329 return ::mlir::success();
330}

336::mlir::ParseResult AddFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
337 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
338 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
339 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
340 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
341 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
342 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
343 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
344 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
345 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
346 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
347
348 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
349 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
350 return ::mlir::failure();
351 if (parser.parseComma())
352 return ::mlir::failure();
353
354 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
355 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
356 return ::mlir::failure();
357 {
358 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
359 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
360 }
361 {
362 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
363 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
364 }
365 {
366 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
367 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
368 return ::mlir::failure();
369 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
370 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
371 })))
372 return ::mlir::failure();
373 }
374 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
375 return ::mlir::failure();
376 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
377 return ::mlir::failure();
378
379 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
380 if (::mlir::failed(AddFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
381 result.location, result.operands,
382 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
383 result.getRawProperties(),
384 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
385 return ::mlir::failure();
386 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
387 return ::mlir::success();
388}

390void AddFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
391 _odsPrinter << ' ';
392 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
393 _odsPrinter << ",";
394 _odsPrinter << ' ';
395 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
396 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
397 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
398 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
399 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
400}

657::llvm::LogicalResult AndFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
658 {
659 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
660 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
661
662 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
663 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
664 return ::mlir::failure();
665 }
666 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
667
668 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
669 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
670 return ::mlir::failure();
671 }
672 }
673 {
674 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
675 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
676
677 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
678 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
679 return ::mlir::failure();
680 }
681 }
682 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
683 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
684 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
685 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
686 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
687 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
688 return ::mlir::success();
689}
690
691::llvm::LogicalResult AndFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
692 return verifyInvariantsImpl();
693}
694
695::mlir::ParseResult AndFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
696 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
697 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
698 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
699 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
700 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
701 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
702 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
703 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
704 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
705 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
706
707 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
708 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
709 return ::mlir::failure();
710 if (parser.parseComma())
711 return ::mlir::failure();
712
713 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
714 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
715 return ::mlir::failure();
716 {
717 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
718 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
719 }
720 {
721 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
722 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
723 }
724 {
725 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
726 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
727 return ::mlir::failure();
728 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
729 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
730 })))
731 return ::mlir::failure();
732 }
733 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
734 return ::mlir::failure();
735 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
736 return ::mlir::failure();
737
738 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
739 if (::mlir::failed(AndFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
740 result.location, result.operands,
741 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
742 result.getRawProperties(),
743 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
744 return ::mlir::failure();
745 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
746 return ::mlir::success();
747}

749void AndFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
750 _odsPrinter << ' ';
751 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
752 _odsPrinter << ",";
753 _odsPrinter << ' ';
754 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
755 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
756 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
757 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
758 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
759}

1016::llvm::LogicalResult DivFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
1017 {
1018 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
1019 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
1020
1021 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
1022 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
1023 return ::mlir::failure();
1024 }
1025 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
1026
1027 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
1028 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
1029 return ::mlir::failure();
1030 }
1031 }
1032 {
1033 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
1034 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
1035
1036 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
1037 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
1038 return ::mlir::failure();
1039 }
1040 }
1041 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
1042 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
1043 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
1044 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
1045 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
1046 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
1047 return ::mlir::success();
1048}
1049
1050::llvm::LogicalResult DivFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
1051 return verifyInvariantsImpl();
1052}

1054::mlir::ParseResult DivFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
1055 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
1056 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
1057 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
1058 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
1059 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
1060 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
1061 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
1062 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
1063 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
1064 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
1065
1066 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
1067 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
1068 return ::mlir::failure();
1069 if (parser.parseComma())
1070 return ::mlir::failure();
1071
1072 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
1073 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
1074 return ::mlir::failure();
1075 {
1076 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
1077 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
1078 }
1079 {
1080 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
1081 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
1082 }
1083 {
1084 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
1085 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
1086 return ::mlir::failure();
1087 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
1088 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
1089 })))
1090 return ::mlir::failure();
1091 }
1092 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
1093 return ::mlir::failure();
1094 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
1095 return ::mlir::failure();
1096
1097 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
1098 if (::mlir::failed(DivFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
1099 result.location, result.operands,
1100 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
1101 result.getRawProperties(),
1102 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
1103 return ::mlir::failure();
1104 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
1105 return ::mlir::success();
1106}

1108void DivFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
1109 _odsPrinter << ' ';
1110 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
1111 _odsPrinter << ",";
1112 _odsPrinter << ' ';
1113 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
1114 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
1115 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
1116 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
1117 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
1118}

1172::llvm::LogicalResult FeltConstantOpAdaptor::verify(::mlir::Location loc) {
1173 auto tblgen_value = getProperties().value; (void)tblgen_value;
1174 if (!tblgen_value) return emitError(loc, "'felt.const' op requires attribute 'value'");
1175
1176 if (tblgen_value && !((::llvm::isa<::llzk::felt::FeltConstAttr>(tblgen_value))))
1177 return emitError(loc, "'felt.const' op attribute 'value' failed to satisfy constraint: finite field element");

1181::llvm::LogicalResult FeltConstantOp::setPropertiesFromAttr(Properties &prop, ::mlir::Attribute attr, ::llvm::function_ref<::mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
1182 ::mlir::DictionaryAttr dict = ::llvm::dyn_cast<::mlir::DictionaryAttr>(attr);
1183 if (!dict) {
1184 emitError() << "expected DictionaryAttr to set properties";
1185 return ::mlir::failure();
1186 }
1187
1188 {
1189 auto &propStorage = prop.value;
1190 auto attr = dict.get("value");
1191 if (attr) {
1192 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
1193 if (convertedAttr) {
1194 propStorage = convertedAttr;
1195 } else {
1196 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `value` in property conversion: " << attr;
1197 return ::mlir::failure();
1198 }
1199 }
1200 }
1201 return ::mlir::success();
1202}

1207
1208 {

1217 return {};

1452::llvm::LogicalResult FeltConstantOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
1453 auto tblgen_value = getProperties().value; (void)tblgen_value;
1454 if (!tblgen_value) return emitOpError("requires attribute 'value'");
1455
1456 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops1(*this, tblgen_value, "value")))
1457 return ::mlir::failure();
1458 {
1459 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
1460 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
1461
1462 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
1463 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
1464 return ::mlir::failure();
1465 }
1466 }
1467 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify(getValue().getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
1468 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with value type");
1469 return ::mlir::success();
1470}

1476::mlir::ParseResult FeltConstantOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
1477 ::llzk::felt::FeltConstAttr valueAttr;
1478
1479 if (parser.parseCustomAttributeWithFallback(valueAttr, ::mlir::Type{})) {
1480 return ::mlir::failure();
1481 }
1482 if (valueAttr) result.getOrAddProperties<FeltConstantOp::Properties>().value = valueAttr;
1483 {
1484 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
1485 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
1486 return ::mlir::failure();
1487 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
1488 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
1489 })))
1490 return ::mlir::failure();
1491 }
1492
1493 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
1494 if (::mlir::failed(FeltConstantOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
1495 result.location, result.operands,
1496 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
1497 result.getRawProperties(),
1498 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
1499 return ::mlir::failure();
1500 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
1501 return ::mlir::success();
1502}

2079::llvm::LogicalResult MulFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
2080 {
2081 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
2082 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
2083
2084 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
2085 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
2086 return ::mlir::failure();
2087 }
2088 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
2089
2090 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
2091 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
2092 return ::mlir::failure();
2093 }
2094 }
2095 {
2096 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
2097 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
2098
2099 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
2100 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
2101 return ::mlir::failure();
2102 }
2103 }
2104 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
2105 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
2106 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
2107 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
2108 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
2109 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
2110 return ::mlir::success();
2111}

2117::mlir::ParseResult MulFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
2118 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
2119 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
2120 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
2121 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
2122 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
2123 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
2124 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
2125 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
2126 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
2127 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
2128
2129 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
2130 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
2131 return ::mlir::failure();
2132 if (parser.parseComma())
2133 return ::mlir::failure();
2134
2135 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
2136 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
2137 return ::mlir::failure();
2138 {
2139 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
2140 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
2141 }
2142 {
2143 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
2144 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
2145 }
2146 {
2147 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
2148 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
2149 return ::mlir::failure();
2150 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
2151 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
2152 })))
2153 return ::mlir::failure();
2154 }
2155 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
2156 return ::mlir::failure();
2157 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
2158 return ::mlir::failure();
2159
2160 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
2161 if (::mlir::failed(MulFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
2162 result.location, result.operands,
2163 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
2164 result.getRawProperties(),
2165 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
2166 return ::mlir::failure();
2167 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
2168 return ::mlir::success();
2169}

2171void MulFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
2172 _odsPrinter << ' ';

2174 _odsPrinter << ",";
2175 _odsPrinter << ' ';
2176 _odsPrinter << getRhs();

2178 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
2179 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
2180 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);

2435::llvm::LogicalResult NegFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
2436 {
2437 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
2438 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
2439
2440 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
2441 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
2442 return ::mlir::failure();
2443 }
2444 }
2445 {
2446 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
2447 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
2448
2449 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
2450 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
2451 return ::mlir::failure();
2452 }
2453 }
2454 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
2455 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with operand type");
2456 return ::mlir::success();
2457}
2458
2459::llvm::LogicalResult NegFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
2460 return verifyInvariantsImpl();
2461}

2463::mlir::ParseResult NegFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
2464 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand operandRawOperand{};
2465 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> operandOperands(&operandRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc operandOperandsLoc;
2466 (void)operandOperandsLoc;
2467 ::mlir::Type operandRawType{};
2468 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> operandTypes(&operandRawType, 1);
2469
2470 operandOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
2471 if (parser.parseOperand(operandRawOperand))
2472 return ::mlir::failure();
2473 {
2474 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, operandRawType, true);
2475 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
2476 }
2477 {
2478 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
2479 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
2480 return ::mlir::failure();
2481 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
2482 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
2483 })))
2484 return ::mlir::failure();
2485 }
2486 if (parser.resolveOperands(operandOperands, operandTypes, operandOperandsLoc, result.operands))
2487 return ::mlir::failure();
2488
2489 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
2490 if (::mlir::failed(NegFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
2491 result.location, result.operands,
2492 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
2493 result.getRawProperties(),
2494 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
2495 return ::mlir::failure();
2496 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
2497 return ::mlir::success();
2498}

2500void NegFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
2501 _odsPrinter << ' ';
2502 _odsPrinter << getOperand();
2503 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getOperand().getType(), true);
2504 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
2505 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
2506}

3447::llvm::LogicalResult PowFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
3448 {
3449 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
3450 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
3451
3452 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
3453 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
3454 return ::mlir::failure();
3455 }
3456 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
3457
3458 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
3459 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
3460 return ::mlir::failure();
3461 }
3462 }
3463 {
3464 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
3465 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
3466
3467 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
3468 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
3469 return ::mlir::failure();
3470 }
3471 }
3472 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
3473 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
3474 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
3475 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
3476 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
3477 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
3478 return ::mlir::success();
3479}

3481::llvm::LogicalResult PowFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
3482 return verifyInvariantsImpl();

3485::mlir::ParseResult PowFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
3486 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
3487 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
3488 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
3489 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
3490 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
3491 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
3492 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
3493 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
3494 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
3495 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
3496
3497 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
3498 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
3499 return ::mlir::failure();
3500 if (parser.parseComma())
3501 return ::mlir::failure();
3502
3503 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
3504 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
3505 return ::mlir::failure();
3506 {
3507 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
3508 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
3509 }
3510 {
3511 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
3512 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
3513 }
3514 {
3515 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
3516 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
3517 return ::mlir::failure();
3518 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
3519 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
3520 })))
3521 return ::mlir::failure();
3522 }
3523 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
3524 return ::mlir::failure();
3525 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
3526 return ::mlir::failure();
3527
3528 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
3529 if (::mlir::failed(PowFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
3530 result.location, result.operands,
3531 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
3532 result.getRawProperties(),
3533 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
3534 return ::mlir::failure();
3535 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
3536 return ::mlir::success();
3537}

3539void PowFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
3540 _odsPrinter << ' ';
3541 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
3542 _odsPrinter << ",";
3543 _odsPrinter << ' ';
3544 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
3545 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
3546 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
3547 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
3548 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
3549}

3806::llvm::LogicalResult ShlFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
3807 {
3808 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
3809 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
3810
3811 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
3812 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
3813 return ::mlir::failure();
3814 }
3815 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
3816
3817 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
3818 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
3819 return ::mlir::failure();
3820 }
3821 }
3822 {
3823 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
3824 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
3825
3826 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
3827 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
3828 return ::mlir::failure();
3829 }
3830 }
3831 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
3832 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
3833 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
3834 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
3835 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
3836 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
3837 return ::mlir::success();
3838}
3839
3840::llvm::LogicalResult ShlFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
3841 return verifyInvariantsImpl();
3842}

3844::mlir::ParseResult ShlFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
3845 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
3846 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
3847 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
3848 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
3849 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
3850 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
3851 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
3852 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
3853 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
3854 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
3855
3856 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
3857 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
3858 return ::mlir::failure();
3859 if (parser.parseComma())
3860 return ::mlir::failure();
3861
3862 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
3863 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
3864 return ::mlir::failure();
3865 {
3866 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
3867 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
3868 }
3869 {
3870 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
3871 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
3872 }
3873 {
3874 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
3875 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
3876 return ::mlir::failure();
3877 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
3878 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
3879 })))
3880 return ::mlir::failure();
3881 }
3882 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
3883 return ::mlir::failure();
3884 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
3885 return ::mlir::failure();
3886
3887 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
3888 if (::mlir::failed(ShlFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
3889 result.location, result.operands,
3890 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
3891 result.getRawProperties(),
3892 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
3893 return ::mlir::failure();
3894 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
3895 return ::mlir::success();
3896}

3898void ShlFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
3899 _odsPrinter << ' ';
3900 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
3901 _odsPrinter << ",";
3902 _odsPrinter << ' ';
3903 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
3904 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
3905 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
3906 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
3907 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
3908}

4165::llvm::LogicalResult ShrFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
4166 {
4167 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
4168 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
4169
4170 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
4171 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
4172 return ::mlir::failure();
4173 }
4174 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
4175
4176 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
4177 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
4178 return ::mlir::failure();
4179 }
4180 }
4181 {
4182 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
4183 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
4184
4185 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
4186 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
4187 return ::mlir::failure();
4188 }
4189 }
4190 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
4191 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
4192 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
4193 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
4194 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
4195 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
4196 return ::mlir::success();
4197}
4198
4199::llvm::LogicalResult ShrFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
4200 return verifyInvariantsImpl();
4201}

4203::mlir::ParseResult ShrFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
4204 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
4205 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
4206 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
4207 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
4208 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
4209 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
4210 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
4211 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
4212 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
4213 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
4214
4215 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
4216 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
4217 return ::mlir::failure();
4218 if (parser.parseComma())
4219 return ::mlir::failure();
4220
4221 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
4222 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
4223 return ::mlir::failure();
4224 {
4225 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
4226 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
4227 }
4228 {
4229 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
4230 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
4231 }
4232 {
4233 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
4234 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
4235 return ::mlir::failure();
4236 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
4237 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
4238 })))
4239 return ::mlir::failure();
4240 }
4241 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
4242 return ::mlir::failure();
4243 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
4244 return ::mlir::failure();
4245
4246 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
4247 if (::mlir::failed(ShrFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
4248 result.location, result.operands,
4249 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
4250 result.getRawProperties(),
4251 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
4252 return ::mlir::failure();
4253 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
4254 return ::mlir::success();
4255}

4257void ShrFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
4258 _odsPrinter << ' ';
4259 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
4260 _odsPrinter << ",";
4261 _odsPrinter << ' ';
4262 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
4263 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
4264 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
4265 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
4266 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
4267}

4562::mlir::ParseResult SignedIntDivFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
4563 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
4564 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
4565 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
4566 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
4567 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
4568 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
4569 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
4570 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
4571 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
4572 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
4573
4574 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
4575 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
4576 return ::mlir::failure();
4577 if (parser.parseComma())
4578 return ::mlir::failure();
4579
4580 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
4581 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
4582 return ::mlir::failure();
4583 {
4584 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
4585 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
4586 }
4587 {
4588 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
4589 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
4590 }
4591 {
4592 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
4593 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
4594 return ::mlir::failure();
4595 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
4596 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
4597 })))
4598 return ::mlir::failure();
4599 }
4600 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
4601 return ::mlir::failure();
4602 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
4603 return ::mlir::failure();
4604
4605 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
4606 if (::mlir::failed(SignedIntDivFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
4607 result.location, result.operands,
4608 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
4609 result.getRawProperties(),
4610 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
4611 return ::mlir::failure();
4612 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
4613 return ::mlir::success();
4614}

4950 {

4952 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))

5242::llvm::LogicalResult SubFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
5243 {
5244 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
5245 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
5246
5247 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
5248 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
5249 return ::mlir::failure();
5250 }
5251 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
5252
5253 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
5254 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
5255 return ::mlir::failure();
5256 }
5257 }
5258 {
5259 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
5260 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
5261
5262 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
5263 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
5264 return ::mlir::failure();
5265 }
5266 }
5267 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
5268 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
5269 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
5270 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
5271 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
5272 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
5273 return ::mlir::success();
5274}

5601::llvm::LogicalResult UnsignedIntDivFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
5602 {
5603 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
5604 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
5605
5606 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
5607 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
5608 return ::mlir::failure();
5609 }
5610 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
5611
5612 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
5613 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
5614 return ::mlir::failure();
5615 }
5616 }
5617 {
5618 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
5619 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
5620
5621 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
5622 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
5623 return ::mlir::failure();
5624 }
5625 }
5626 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
5627 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
5628 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
5629 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
5630 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
5631 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
5632 return ::mlir::success();
5633}

5639::mlir::ParseResult UnsignedIntDivFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
5640 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
5641 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
5642 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
5643 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
5644 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
5645 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
5646 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
5647 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
5648 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
5649 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
5650
5651 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
5652 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
5653 return ::mlir::failure();
5654 if (parser.parseComma())
5655 return ::mlir::failure();
5656
5657 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
5658 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
5659 return ::mlir::failure();
5660 {
5661 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
5662 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
5663 }
5664 {
5665 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
5666 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
5667 }
5668 {
5669 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
5670 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
5671 return ::mlir::failure();
5672 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
5673 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
5674 })))
5675 return ::mlir::failure();
5676 }
5677 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
5678 return ::mlir::failure();
5679 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
5680 return ::mlir::failure();
5681
5682 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
5683 if (::mlir::failed(UnsignedIntDivFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
5684 result.location, result.operands,
5685 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
5686 result.getRawProperties(),
5687 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
5688 return ::mlir::failure();
5689 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
5690 return ::mlir::success();
5691}

5960::llvm::LogicalResult UnsignedModFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
5961 {
5962 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
5963 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
5964
5965 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
5966 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
5967 return ::mlir::failure();
5968 }
5969 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
5970
5971 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
5972 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
5973 return ::mlir::failure();
5974 }
5975 }
5976 {
5977 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
5978 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
5979
5980 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
5981 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
5982 return ::mlir::failure();
5983 }
5984 }
5985 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
5986 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
5987 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
5988 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
5989 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
5990 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
5991 return ::mlir::success();
5992}
5993
5994::llvm::LogicalResult UnsignedModFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
5995 return verifyInvariantsImpl();
5996}

5998::mlir::ParseResult UnsignedModFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
5999 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
6000 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
6001 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
6002 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
6003 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
6004 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
6005 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
6006 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
6007 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
6008 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
6009
6010 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
6011 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
6012 return ::mlir::failure();
6013 if (parser.parseComma())
6014 return ::mlir::failure();
6015
6016 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
6017 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
6018 return ::mlir::failure();
6019 {
6020 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
6021 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
6022 }
6023 {
6024 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
6025 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
6026 }
6027 {
6028 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
6029 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
6030 return ::mlir::failure();
6031 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
6032 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
6033 })))
6034 return ::mlir::failure();
6035 }
6036 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
6037 return ::mlir::failure();
6038 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
6039 return ::mlir::failure();
6040
6041 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
6042 if (::mlir::failed(UnsignedModFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
6043 result.location, result.operands,
6044 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
6045 result.getRawProperties(),
6046 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
6047 return ::mlir::failure();
6048 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
6049 return ::mlir::success();
6050}

6052void UnsignedModFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
6053 _odsPrinter << ' ';
6054 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
6055 _odsPrinter << ",";
6056 _odsPrinter << ' ';
6057 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
6058 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
6059 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
6060 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
6061 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
6062}

6319::llvm::LogicalResult XorFeltOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
6320 {
6321 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
6322 auto valueGroup0 = getODSOperands(0);
6323
6324 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
6325 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
6326 return ::mlir::failure();
6327 }
6328 auto valueGroup1 = getODSOperands(1);
6329
6330 for (auto v : valueGroup1) {
6331 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops1(*this, v.getType(), "operand", index++)))
6332 return ::mlir::failure();
6333 }
6334 }
6335 {
6336 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
6337 auto valueGroup0 = getODSResults(0);
6338
6339 for (auto v : valueGroup0) {
6340 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_type_constraint_Ops2(*this, v.getType(), "result", index++)))
6341 return ::mlir::failure();
6342 }
6343 }
6344 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType()))))
6345 return emitOpError("failed to verify that rhs type matches with lhs type");
6346 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(0).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
6347 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with lhs type");
6348 if (!((::llzk::typesUnify((*this->getODSOperands(1).begin()).getType(), (*this->getODSResults(0).begin()).getType()))))
6349 return emitOpError("failed to verify that result type matches with rhs type");
6350 return ::mlir::success();
6351}

6353::llvm::LogicalResult XorFeltOp::verifyInvariants() {
6354 return verifyInvariantsImpl();

6357::mlir::ParseResult XorFeltOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
6358 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand lhsRawOperand{};
6359 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> lhsOperands(&lhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc lhsOperandsLoc;
6360 (void)lhsOperandsLoc;
6361 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand rhsRawOperand{};
6362 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> rhsOperands(&rhsRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc rhsOperandsLoc;
6363 (void)rhsOperandsLoc;
6364 ::mlir::Type lhsRawType{};
6365 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> lhsTypes(&lhsRawType, 1);
6366 ::mlir::Type rhsRawType{};
6367 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> rhsTypes(&rhsRawType, 1);
6368
6369 lhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
6370 if (parser.parseOperand(lhsRawOperand))
6371 return ::mlir::failure();
6372 if (parser.parseComma())
6373 return ::mlir::failure();
6374
6375 rhsOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
6376 if (parser.parseOperand(rhsRawOperand))
6377 return ::mlir::failure();
6378 {
6379 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, lhsRawType, true);
6380 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
6381 }
6382 {
6383 auto odsResult = parseInferredOrParsedType(parser, rhsRawType, false);
6384 if (odsResult) return ::mlir::failure();
6385 }
6386 {
6387 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
6388 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
6389 return ::mlir::failure();
6390 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
6391 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
6392 })))
6393 return ::mlir::failure();
6394 }
6395 if (parser.resolveOperands(lhsOperands, lhsTypes, lhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
6396 return ::mlir::failure();
6397 if (parser.resolveOperands(rhsOperands, rhsTypes, rhsOperandsLoc, result.operands))
6398 return ::mlir::failure();
6399
6400 ::llvm::SmallVector<::mlir::Type> inferredReturnTypes;
6401 if (::mlir::failed(XorFeltOp::inferReturnTypes(parser.getContext(),
6402 result.location, result.operands,
6403 result.attributes.getDictionary(parser.getContext()),
6404 result.getRawProperties(),
6405 result.regions, inferredReturnTypes)))
6406 return ::mlir::failure();
6407 result.addTypes(inferredReturnTypes);
6408 return ::mlir::success();
6409}

6411void XorFeltOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
6412 _odsPrinter << ' ';
6413 _odsPrinter << getLhs();
6414 _odsPrinter << ",";
6415 _odsPrinter << ' ';
6416 _odsPrinter << getRhs();
6417 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getLhs().getType(), true);
6418 printInferredOrParsedType(_odsPrinter, *this, getRhs().getType(), false);
6419 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
6420 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
6421}
